translation_notes: prefixes: SSTIM->sstim, SSTIM_V->sstimv (with `as SSTIM_V` since the body still indexes it with SSTIM_V[name] -- a Namespace subscript, which has no island form), SSTIM_EX->sstimex, RDF->rdf, SKOS->skos.

Every graph.objects/subjects one-step read becomes m{ }; every next(graph.objects(...), None) becomes m{ }.first(); the sorted(graph.subjects(...)) traversal keeps its Python sorted() around a m{ } iterable.

module_paths()/instance_paths() (manifest + directory walk, not RDF) are outside the region's context; shim.py supplies them, pointed at fixture_module.ttl/fixture_instance.ttl for both sides. main() takes no argument, so the driver calls it with no fixture= graph -- the two ttl files ARE the fixture.

repair.driver: entry is now demo(), added identically to both sides: it captures main()'s stderr report and returns (exit code, stderr), and can point module_paths()/instance_paths() at other files; the first call (shim.py's files) is kept, now with its report compared; new scenarios: everything passes (return 0, success line with the four counts, every association count exactly at its threshold, a decoy carrying every predicate listed first, skos:note/editorialNote neighbours, blank-node band, falsy bounds and empty note), one failure per check (outcome word under each of the four skos predicates, hzMin > hzMax, half intervals, range above/below its band, equal extended bounds, missing extendedHzMax, band without interval, no typical band, two extendedHzMin, association counts one below threshold beside neighbours), no band at all, no file at all.

typical band / extendedHzMin / extendedHzMax subject widened

optimization_notes: optimized.py: the seven next(graph.objects(s, p), None) become graph.value(s, p); assessed/statuses are inlined into `found`; `total` is inlined into the success message; one failures.append is joined onto one line. Kept: the two parse loops apart (section 1 reads the module graph before the instances are parsed), every guard, counter, comment, and the stderr report. The demo() harness is copied as is.

optimized.ldpy is optimized.py with `@graph graph`, the reads as m{ } (`.first()` for graph.value, `a` for rdf:type), and `len(set(...))` as `.count()`: a single pattern over a Graph yields distinct solutions, so the count equals the size of the set.
No exception to symmetry: `.count()` replaces the set and len of the same read, it does not restructure the code.
